## API Dashboard feed
Reads every geohazard table and returns the JSON the dashboard draws. Generated from src/dashboard-api.js; edit the source, not the Code node.

**Trigger:** GET https://chlooood.app.n8n.cloud/webhook/terracorridor-v2/corridor
**Reads:** corridor_sources, corridor_segments, corridor_predictions, corridor_baselines, corridor_build, corridor_build_config, corridor_watch, corridor_work_orders, corridor_audit, corridor_class, corridor_deadlines, corridor_obligations
**v2 addition:** "Add class and obligations" (not in the repo) adds class_location (W6 + W11) and land_obligations (W8) to each segment. It removes solar fields and the risk-score-to-dollars estimate (config.money). Response-option costs in the class decision (capex, recurringYr, total, lowestCost, pricedWithPlaceholders) are kept; they are labelled placeholders. studyAreaAcres is kept. "Build dashboard JSON" is unchanged. It still needs corridor_build and corridor_build_config, so the feed reads them, and their solar fields are removed before the response.
**Writes:** Nothing
**Next:** Open dist/dashboard.html?api=https://chlooood.app.n8n.cloud/webhook/terracorridor-v2

Part of the v2 set. Hackathon originals are untouched. Source of truth: github.com/katiescase/terracorridor/workflows. Change the repo and re-import, do not hand-edit.
